from AlgorithmImports import *


class ParallelStrategiesAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY).symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = self.sma(self.spy, 20, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.rsi(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS, Resolution.DAILY)

        self.spy_sma_history = RollingWindow[float](2)
        self.aapl_close_history = RollingWindow[float](2)
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        if any(symbol not in data.bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        spy_bar = data.bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.bars[self.aapl]

        if self.aapl_close_history.count > 0:
            if aapl_bar.close < self.aapl_close_history[0]:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        sma_ready_before_update = self.spy_sma_history.count == 2
        sma_current = float(self.spy_sma.current.value)

        if sma_ready_before_update:
            sma_yesterday = self.spy_sma_history[0]
            sma_day_before_yesterday = self.spy_sma_history[1]
            spy_close_yesterday = spy_bar.close

            strategy_a_sell = (
                self.strategy_a_lot > 0
                and sma_day_before_yesterday is not None
                and sma_yesterday is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close <= sma_day_before_yesterday
                and spy_close_yesterday < sma_yesterday
            )

            strategy_a_buy = (
                self.strategy_a_lot == 0
                and self.previous_spy_close <= sma_day_before_yesterday
                and spy_close_yesterday > sma_yesterday
            )
        else:
            strategy_a_sell = False
            strategy_a_buy = False

        strategy_b_sell = (
            self.strategy_b_lot > 0
            and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
            and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60
        )
        strategy_b_buy = self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3

        if strategy_a_sell:
            self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if strategy_b_sell:
            self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if strategy_a_buy:
            quantity = int((0.40 * self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value) // spy_bar.close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if strategy_b_buy and self.portfolio.cash_book["USD"].amount >= 20_000:
            quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_bar.close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
                self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.spy_sma_history.add(sma_current)
        self.aapl_close_history.add(aapl_bar.close)
        self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.close

        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)

        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if symbol == self.aapl and data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                close = data.Bars[symbol].Close
                if self.previous_aapl_close is not None and close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
                self.previous_aapl_close = close

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            self._UpdateSpyCrossState(data)
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            self._UpdateSpyCrossState(data)
            return

        spy_sma_value = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma_value
        )
        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma_value
        )

        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) // spy_close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self._UpdateSpyCrossState(data)

    def _UpdateSpyCrossState(self, data: Slice):
        if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            return

        if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
